title: Register Shifting: Translating Slang to Formal Hungarian
grammar: Register shifting: converting colloquial discourse to formal and administrative Hungarian
goal: I can replace a slang word with its formal equivalent
I can name the registers: szleng, köznyelvi, hivatalos
I can say which register suits a letter to an office and which a chat with a friend
